title: Airport Security Sucks!
summary: A multiplayer airport security game about spotting smugglers hiding in a crowd, controlling travelers with voice commands, and embracing procedural chaos.
imageAlt: Airport Security Sucks! Steam capsule artwork
tagline: Run airport security. Find the contraband. Try not to level the terminal.
overview: Airport Security Sucks! turns the checkpoint into a loud multiplayer sandbox. Security officers inspect, interrogate, and control a crowd of suspicious travelers while smugglers improvise increasingly ridiculous ways through the line.
studioNote: Airport Security Sucks! was made under Jatater Worldwide, the game studio run by Connor Myers / Metater and JakeHub.
heroImageAlt: A busy airport security checkpoint viewed from above

gallery.alt: A security officer facing an explosion in the airport terminal
First-person security gameplay during an explosive terminal incident
Players searching an airplane cabin for contraband

highlights.title: Asymmetric multiplayer
highlights.description: Security officers control the checkpoint while smugglers hide contraband, bluff, and exploit the chaos.

highlights.title: Voice-driven control
highlights.description: Spoken interactions and proximity voice make every inspection feel immediate, social, and unpredictable.

highlights.title: Systemic comedy
highlights.description: Crowds, gadgets, physics, weapons, and player decisions combine into stories the game never had to script.

highlights.title: Built to scale
highlights.description: The shipped game connects multiplayer infrastructure with a heavily simulated terminal full of moving parts.
